methods.description: Progressive disclosure of the Sail authoring surface from compiler SSOT. Pass topic: core | layout | style | tokens | l1 | control-flow.

topic.description: core | layout | style | tokens | l1 | control-flow

methods.description: Run Sail lint/compile diagnostics for a file path or inline source. Returns structured JSON diagnostics (severity, rule, message, line/col, optional rewrite FixPlan). Optional `fix`: off|suggest|apply for confluent allow-listed rewrites (sail-compose-rhythm, sail-compose-contrast, sail-compose-spacing, sail-no-raw-container, spinnaker typo, participation-style, display-on-layout, prefer-primitive). Prefer `source` for snippets; `path` is workspace-relative only (path escape refused — WI4).

fix.description: Auto-fix: `off` | `suggest` | `apply`. Default `off` (unattended). `suggest` attaches machine fix payloads without writing; `apply` rewrites the file when `path` is set (or returns fixed `source` when inline).

includeTs.description: When true (default), merge mapped tsgo TypeScript diagnostics into structure/check results (SPEC-LSP-1 studio gutters). Soft-noops when tsgo is absent. Set `false` for structure-only / faster agent polls.

path.description: Workspace-relative path (WI4: path escape refused). Prefer with no `source` to read disk; absolute / `..` paths are PermissionDenied.

source.description: Inline source — unrestricted (source mode; WI4 leaves this unchanged).

methods.description: Typed hover at a 1-based .sail position. Uses sail-lsp virtual_ts + tsgo for controller/scope/template TS regions; structure symbols otherwise. Soft-degrades when tsgo is absent.

contents.description: Markdown hover contents. Empty/absent when nothing to show.

methods.description: Completions at a 1-based .sail position. Proxies tsgo inside TS regions; falls back to structure scope symbols. Soft-degrades when tsgo is absent.

Structured grammar-aware Sail edits (insert/replace/wrap/setAttr/removeAttr/setSx/move) or full-content check-guarded write (writeSource + empty ops + source body). Atomic; validates before write so the file never holds an uncompilable intermediate (applied:false leaves bytes unchanged). Supersedes retired sail_apply. Optional WI7 `identity` scopes the edit to a component (path from identity.file; nodeIds rewritten on drift). Response: applied, modelRevision, diagnostics, autoFixed[].

dryRun.description: When true, validate and return result without writing disk.

identity.description: WI7 element identity target. Scopes the edit to the resolved component (path from `identity.file`; ops nodeIds rewritten when the element moved).

ops.description: Atomic batch of structured ops (`insert`/`replace`/`wrap`/`setAttr`/ `removeAttr`/`setSx`/`move`). For full-content write pass `[]` with `writeSource: true` and the complete body in `source` (WI3 check-guard).

path.description: Workspace-relative `.sail` path. Optional when `identity.file` is set (WI7 identity-scoped target).

source.description: Optional inline source (else file is read). With `writeSource: true` and empty `ops`, this is the full file body to check-guard and commit. Combined with dryRun for validate-only.

writeSource.description: Full-content check-guarded write (WI3). When true with empty `ops` and a string `source`, run check on the body; on error diagnostics leave the file byte-identical and return `applied: false`; on success write and return diagnostics for the new state. Prefer over any patch DSL.

identity.description: Resolved live identity when an identity-scoped edit was requested.

methods.description: Taffy layout feedback for agents: multi-viewport diagnostics + computed box tree (x/y/w/h, collapsed flags). Run after layout edits. Prefer `source` for snippets.
List workspace-relative .sail paths under a project (routes/src/packs). Studio explorer seed.

project.description: Workspace-relative project root (e.g. `.` for an external app, or `apps/<name>` in a monorepo). Default: ops project.

methods.description: Compiler policy registry (SPEC-POLICY-1). mode=list returns types/defaults/descriptions; mode=get returns the same rows plus resolved values. Same payload as `sail-compiler policy --json` and GET /_deck/policy.

project.description: Optional project directory for `get` (workspace-relative or absolute).

methods.description: IR query interface (TOOLING-1 WI5). Pass topic: tree | geometry | cascade | states | a11y | invalidations | uses | cost | themes. Read-only projections; tree nodes carry WI7 identity. Optional path, viewport (geometry), token (cascade), themeId, nodeId.

nodeId.description: Optional filter to one tree node id.

token.description: Cascade: design token path or cssName tail.

topic.description: tree | geometry | cascade | states | a11y | invalidations | uses | cost | themes

methods.description: Canonical per-file Sail model (tree, layout, state, diagnostics, data, theme). Source-derived; modelVersion 1.

source.description: Author `.sail` source (same bytes Model inspected). Studio Source view.

methods.description: IR element tree with span-keyed node ids for a .sail file.
Scope bindings with template readers/writers and SSR tier badges (S/I/C).
Blast radius for a design token: component count + source sites (file + span).
DTCG theme graph: tiers, {alias} edges, values from theme JSON only (never CSS).
List theme JSON files under a directory. Path must be themes/** or packages/sail/tokens/model/themes.
Read a project or catalog theme JSON file (workspace-relative path).
Write a project theme JSON. Allowlist: themes/**/*.json.
Delete a project theme JSON. Allowlist: themes/**/*.json (catalog refused).
Fork a catalog or project theme into themes/. Optional new_id rewrites $extensions.ship.themeId.
Run DTCG model → tokens CSS/registry generate. mode=package (full catalog) or mode=app (T0 effective set → project/.sail/themes/themes.css only).
List effective theme ids for a project: project stems + catalog allowlist (T0 enabled ∩ catalog files).
Derive chromatic scale steps from anchors (engine). No file writes. anchors in, solid/hover/subtle/border/text out.
Contrast/contract gate on an in-memory theme (engine). Floor pairs fail. No file writes.
Read registry v2 (schema, catalog ids, contrastPairs, metadata, optional full registry). No file writes.
Search Google Fonts catalog (bundled) by family query + optional category/limit. Empty query returns popular families. Offline after catalog bake.

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. `serif`, `sans-serif`, `display`, `mono`). `all` / empty is ignored. Backend normalizes case.

limit.description: Max hits to return (clamped 1..=80 server-side; default 40).

query.description: Family substring filter (case-insensitive). Empty → popularity order.

catalogSize.description: Full catalog size before limit/filter (discoverer honesty).

category.description: Echo of applied category filter when present.

hits.description: Structured hits (family + category + popularity + mono). Preferred over families-only.

methods.description: Vendor a font family: download subsetted woff2 → project/fonts + @font-face + license manifest + typography tokens. Offline after selection; no runtime CDN.

project.description: App root (project-relative; external app or monorepo `apps/<name>`). Defaults to ctx project / first apps/* with routes.

methods.description: Start (or ensure) a local sail dev server for a project so HMR/studio HTTP exists. Theme ops do not require a server.
Status of the MCP-tracked dev server (running, url).
Stop the MCP-started dev server only (does not kill unrelated sail dev processes).
List ephemeral project tasks under <project>/.sail/tasks (gitignored). Filters: status/label/actor/drift/open. Includes anchor drift.
Get full task JSON (title, status, anchor, events, artifacts, drift).
Create a task (ULID id) under <project>/.sail/tasks. Optional anchor + body. Ephemeral — not team SSOT.

anchor.description: WI7 identity / A-anchor `{ nodeId, elementPath?, contentHash?, file?, span?, locator? }`.

methods.description: Update task fields. Status changes append a status event (any→any in v1).
Append a comment to the task thread.
Attach an artifact (≤5MB). kind file|render; render carries region metadata. content_base64+filename or path.
Append an agent progress/summary note (actor kind=agent).
Create an A-anchored thread (required WI7 identity anchor { nodeId, elementPath?, contentHash?, locator? }). Same store as Create.

anchor.description: Required WI7 identity / A-anchor `{ nodeId, elementPath?, contentHash?, file?, span?, locator? }`.

methods.description: Reply on a thread (comment with actor attribution).
List threads with anchor drift (ok|moved|lost). Filters: open/actor/drift/status.
Explicitly re-anchor a thread to a new node (lost never rebinds silently).
Export thread as a decision record under <project>/decisions/ (committable). .sail/tasks stays gitignored.
Static themed screenshot from a .sail file or inline source (no browser). Returns PNG base64 + regions (node ids) + dynamics list.

theme.description: Theme id (e.g. `ship`). Mode may be folded as `ship-dark`.
